items.title: Cedar Walton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Jack DeJohnette was just arriving into New York from Chicago; and uh, we quickly groomed him for the trio behind Abbey Lincoln.

ctx.x: And gettin' with Abbey. Okay. So uh, uh, Mr. Moses on drums had to, had to go home on a family emergency; Jack DeJohnette was just arriving into New York from Chicago; and uh, we quickly groomed him for the trio behind Abbey Lincoln. Abbey Lincoln and the Cedar
Walton Trio. Must have been a thirteen week engagement at a place named Wells in Harlem. That's the home of Chicken and Waffles, yeah, uh …
